summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on 31 July 2026 announcing the conclusion of a statutory audit tender process. The Board confirmed the re-appointment of Deloitte LLP as statutory auditor effective from the 2028 financial year, subject to shareholder approval at the 2027 AGM. The tender was required by legislation due to periodic rotation; Deloitte had served since 2018 and the audit must be tendered every 10 years. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic change, or material financial event is involved. No deal terms or advisors beyond the audit appointment are mentioned. Consider it a regulatory compliance update with no risk-arb angle.
